entity.name: City of Miami

The City of Miami is the seat of Miami-Dade County, the most populous county in Florida located in between the Everglades and Biscayne National Parks. The city covers an area of 56.6 square miles and is known as the “Magic City”. According to the most recent U.S. Census estimates, 441,003 people call Miami home. Diversity is one of the hallmarks that defines us, and we draw strength from it as many of our residents come from the Caribbean and Central and South America. In fact, 70% of our population is Hispanic or Latino.

In 2016, the City of Miami was chosen along with the City of Miami Beach and Miami-Dade County as regional partners to join 100 Resilient Cities’ (100RC) global network which was founded by the Rockefeller Foundation. Miami is a Future City and as such, the city is addressing rising seas and climate concerns. 

City voters approved the Miami Forever Bond in November 2017 and the initial phase of the program was launched in December of 2018. The funding is earmarked for five key categories, including $192M allocated to mitigate the most severe current and future flood risks and vulnerability through strategic infrastructure investments. Some of the projects included are tidal backflow prevention valves, raised roads, and stormwater pumps to keep our streets dry and seawalls to protect our neighborhoods. The City is actively cultivating public and private partnerships in advancing its ambitious climate resilience strategy, which also includes non-infrastructure measures such as land use planning, building codes and hurricane preparedness.

With over 50 years of experience in the real estate business, the MIMCO-managed portfolio has grown to include over 350 properties in Texas, New Mexico and Arizona encompassing over 8.5 million square feet of properties.

MIMCO’s retail properties range in size from 1,200 to 276,000 square feet and office/warehouse projects up to 196,000 square feet. MIMCO currently has approximately 1,900 leases in its portfolio, including many tenants with multiple locations. Additionally, MIMCO has managed construction projects ranging from small single-user to multi-million dollar multi-tenant projects, including ground up construction and the complete renovation of existing developments. MIMCO only manages properties in which its owners have a direct financial investment. MIMCO, therefore, takes great pride and extra care to ensure that its properties are well-constructed, well-maintained and that the property management and maintenance teams are responsive to tenants’ needs. Execution of these goals has been the key to MIMCO’s success, resulting in strong tenant relationships and repeat business opportunities.

With over 50 employees, MIMCO’s team has extensive knowledge across multiple asset classes and is able to provide in-house expertise in acquisition, development, construction management, financing, accounting and reporting, legal, property management and leasing. Members of the MIMCO team are leaders in the commercial real estate industry and their communities. Over the last five decades, MIMCO has built a reputation as an organization with integrity, and a commitment tomanaging and operating projects that strengthen the community, enhance surrounding neighborhoods, and provide opportunities for a variety of businesses.

We look forward to working with you on a potential acquisition or in helping you find your next location to lease!
